name: ReflexED
tagline: Teachers upload one lesson and every student gets it in the format that fits how they learn.
problem: Teachers lack time to reformat material; students learn differently.
solution: A learning environment that turns one upload into personalised formats such as narrated explainers and interactive versions.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a physics chapter and see versions for different learners.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Inclusive Innovation Hack (Dell Technologies)” among 124 submissions.
The builder advises a school board on innovation.

lessons: Serve both the teacher's time and the student's needs.
